parts.text: In our project xHub (Supervision of Autonomous Robot Tractors in Warehouses and Logistics Platforms), we are still looking for a post-doc in eXplainable AI. Details (in French) via this link or in the attached doc:

Contract Details:
● Start Date: March 1, 2026. ● Duration: 12 months. ● Work Location: Distributed Knowledge and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CIAD), University of Technology of Belfort-Montbéliard (UTBM), Belfort, France. ● Supervisors: Dr. Yazan Mualla (UTBM) in collaboration with Dr. Françoise Fessant (Orange, Paris).
